name: Dagger of Venom

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Coat in Poison
powers.text: Magic action: thick black poison coats the blade for 1 minute or until you hit (once per dawn).

summary: +1 dagger; once a day, poison it: the next creature hit makes a DC 15 Con save or takes 2d10 Poison and is Poisoned.
text: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. You can take a Magic action to cause thick, black poison to coat the blade. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The weapon can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
